edits.old: Then the gap is named by its identifier and no value is invented for it
edits.new:
Then the gap is named by its identifier and no value is invented for it

  Scenario: AC8 Every business rule of section 8 has a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules of section 8 and their coverage line
    When the coverage line is checked against sections 7 and 16
    Then BR1 to BR9 each name at least one criterion of section 7 and one test case of section 16
    Then a rule with no criterion or no test fails the contract review

  Scenario: AC9 The error answers 401, 403 and 404 are named for the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the contract declares no REST path of its own and the element is read through the treatment representation
    When the error answers of the provided operations are linted
    Then a request without a valid credential is answered 401, a request the caller may not make is answered 403 and a treatment that is not found is answered 404
    Then a provided operation that names no answer for 401, 403 or 404 fails the lint

  Scenario: AC10 A retried or timed-out read is answered and never guessed (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a read of recovery.v_ace_payment is retried or times out
    When the retry and the timeout are linted
    Then the retry count and the timeout are read from governed reference data and are not fixed in the document
    Then a read that times out is answered with MSG-GEN-006 and never with guessed evidence

| TC-S2-E3011-CON-06 | AC7 | Contract | A value no source names: the working read published and the gap left open; no value invented for it |
